shots.dialogue: トアン: 来るぞ……ひるむな！
shots.prompt: Mongol vanguard cavalry charging in a dust cloud, a ragtag militia of young soldiers bracing spears, the boy at the front shouting a command, dynamic tracking camera, tense, dawn light

shots.dialogue: トアン: やれる……俺にもやれるんだ！
shots.prompt: the boy fiercely charging and unhorsing a Mongol rider with his curved sword, exhilarated flushed face, fast action, motion blur, sparks of clashing steel, low heroic angle

shots.narration: だが戦場は、勢いだけの少年に容赦しなかった。
shots.prompt: a battle-hardened Mongol officer overpowers the boy, knocking his sword away, the boy thrown to the ground beneath a war horse, desperate, dust and chaos, dramatic high angle, danger

shots.dialogue: イェッ・キエウ: 死に急ぐなよ、若殿。命は何度も使えない。
shots.prompt: a lean young man bursts out from the river with damp hair, knocks the enemy back and pulls the boy up, easygoing grin, water splashing, heroic rescue moment, splashes catching light

shots.dialogue: トアン: すげぇ……あれが、戦い方……。
shots.prompt: the young man dives underwater and slashes the hull of a Mongol river boat, the boat sinking with panicked soldiers, the boy watching in awe from the bank, underwater-to-surface cut, dynamic

shots.dialogue: マイ: 無茶ばかり……。生きててくれなきゃ、意味がない。 / トアン: ……ああ。強くなる。
shots.prompt: a quiet field camp at dusk, the girl gently treating the boy's wound with herbal medicine, his face mixing frustration and realization, soft firelight, intimate close two-shot, tender

shots.narration: 脱歓の本隊、二十万。退却の角笛が、戦場を裂いた。
shots.prompt: the horizon turns black with the endless main Mongol army under banners, a retreat horn echoing, soldiers turning to fall back, overwhelming scale, ominous wide shot, cold light

shots.dialogue: 陳興道(影): 退いて、勝つ。それが戦だ。
shots.caption: ――次回、焦土。
shots.prompt: a messenger shouting the retreat order, the boy gritting his teeth in defiance, the shadow of a mounted general falling over him from behind, hard cut to black, dramatic cliffhanger
